title: هدف منتج قابل للتحقق
rule:
Applies when: Before executing a task.
Define the authorized outcome, boundaries and acceptance criteria; do not substitute task counts or empty pending lists for product success.
rationale: غياب نتيجة مخولة ومعيار قبول يمنع إثبات نجاح المنتج. PROVISIONAL_OWNER_REVIEW
reviewCadence: Owner review before activation and after material changes
